inventory.name: 1iep

experimental_metadata._struct.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF THE C-ABL KINASE DOMAIN IN COMPLEX WITH STI-571.
experimental_metadata._struct_keywords.text: KINASE, KINASE INHIBITOR, STI-571, ACTIVATION LOOP, TRANSFERASE

inventory.missing_atom_check: Backbone preflight; full residue-template matching by Meeko at preparation. Numbering gaps are indicators, not a sequence reconstruction.

receptor.hydrogen_protonation_method: Meeko 0.7.1 residue templates add/match hydrogens; default residue states unless residue_templates supplied. No pKa calculation, pH optimization, or missing-heavy-atom repair.
receptor.missing_residues_policy: Unresolved sequence residues are reported, not rebuilt. Existing residues must pass strict Meeko matching; no allow_bad_res.

preparation.protonation: Input formal charges and tautomer preserved; explicit Hs from RDKit valence. No pH prediction or tautomer enumeration.
preparation.charge_method: Meeko Gasteiger; Vina scoring uses atom types, not electrostatic partial charges

validation.criterion: Top-scoring pose symmetry-aware heavy atom RMSD <= threshold in the original receptor frame; no superposition
validation.reference: PDB 1IEP chain A residue STI 201; CCD bond orders, original experimental coordinates
validation.method: All chirality-aware identical-graph mappings; minimum in-place heavy atom RMSD
validation.caveat: Passing one redocking case is not general validation of affinity ranking or prospective screening.
validation.protocol: Official Vina tutorial box; raw 1IEP chain A prepared strictly with Meeko; chloride and water removal recorded; de novo ETKDG ligand conformer

limitations: Vina scores are computed docking scores in kcal/mol, not experimentally measured binding affinities. They do not establish efficacy, toxicity, pharmacokinetics, or clinical usefulness.
Rigid receptor, implicit solvent, one input protonation/tautomer state and limited ligand sampling. No induced fit, free-energy calculation or pKa prediction.
Vina pose-relative RMSD lower/upper bounds compare docked poses to the best docked pose; they are distinct from crystallographic heavy-atom RMSD.
Only scores from this consistent Vina protocol are ranked. Cross-target, cross-grid or cross-protocol comparisons are not validated.
Missing residues are reported but not reconstructed. Unsupported residues, incomplete heavy atoms and unsupported chemistry fail explicitly.
Approximately 2 A reference RMSD is a useful redocking criterion, not universal proof of screening accuracy. One benchmark is not broad validation.
Exact repeatability is verified on the same executable/platform/CPU count; cross-platform floating-point and search differences can occur.
